dogecoin.text: Your average investor is not going to invest into any coin other than $BTC, $DOGE, $NFT's, and maybe $ETH. We are the minority that knows about everything else. And that's how we make our money. But also should note, you're not going to get massive spikes of money like #BTC  will

Ive come to the conclusion that $DOGE is a better driver for the crypto community than $BTC. #BTC community is toxic, #DOGE is fun, appeals to the lowest common denominator, and is beginning to see payment adoption/utility.

What we INVEST into is mostly infrastructure at the end of the day.
But for non-crypto ppl, where does crypto fit into their life?
Whomever answers that, will be most successful.
Is $Doge the answer? Maybe, rlly just for payments but nothing else.
